faq.q: What analysis does it do beyond a basic EMI figure?
faq.a: It builds a full amortisation schedule (yearly or monthly view) using the standard EMI formula, shows principal-vs-interest charts, and reports EMI, total interest, total payment, processing fee and effective cost. Separate panels model prepayments, a moratorium/EMI holiday, a floating-rate change, side-by-side offer comparison, and loan eligibility.

faq.q: How does the prepayment analysis work?
faq.a: You pick a one-time lump sum, recurring monthly, or recurring annual prepayment, a starting month, and a strategy: 'Reduce Tenure' (keep the EMI, finish sooner) or 'Reduce EMI' (keep the tenure, recompute a lower EMI). It then shows interest saved, months of tenure reduced, and the new total interest versus the original.

faq.q: Can I compare different bank offers and check eligibility?
faq.a: Yes. The comparison section takes up to 3 offers (amount, rate, tenure, processing fee) and ranks them by effective cost, flagging the cheapest. The eligibility estimator applies a FOIR assumption (default 50%) to your income minus existing EMIs to approximate the maximum loan — it's an estimate, since banks use their own criteria.

faq.q: What do the moratorium and floating-rate tools show?
faq.a: The moratorium tool capitalises the interest that accrues during an EMI holiday at the start of the loan, showing the accrued interest, the new (higher) principal and the revised EMI. The floating-rate what-if changes the rate from a chosen month while keeping the EMI fixed, showing the extra interest and tenure change. You can export the schedule as CSV or print it. All figures are planning estimates — confirm with your lender.
